title: TSS-MPRA Protocol
author: Carlos Guzman

steps.title: Initial RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from samples using TRIzol™ LS Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µL of TRIzol™ LS Reagent (Thermo Fisher #10296010) per 250 µL of sample volume (3x) and pipette up and down 5x. (Optional: store samples at 4 °C ON or -20 °C for up to a year).
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes.
Add 230 µL of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol 24:1 (Merck MilliporeSigma #C0549) and shake vigorously by hand for 15 seconds.
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge samples for 15 minutes at 13,000 x g and 4 °C.
Transfer the aqueous layer (~400-500 µL) containing the RNA to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Purification
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the extracted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of GlycoBlue Coprecipitant (Thermo Fisher #AM9515) to each sample.
Add 1/10th volume of 3M NaOAc (pH 5.5) to each sample.
Vortex for 5 seconds and add 1x volume of isopropanol. Mix by inverting 10 times and spin down briefly.
Incubate overnight (ON) at -20 °C (optionally 20 minutes at -20 °C).
Centrifuge samples for 30 minutes at MAX x g and 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and wash with 1 mL 75% EtOH. Discard EtOH, quick-spin, and remove remaining EtOH.
Air dry pellet at RT until translucent (~3 minutes). (Optional: pellet can be frozen at -80 °C indefinitely).

steps.title: First CIP Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of Calf Intestinal Phosphatase (CIP) treatment.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 30 µL TE’T [0.05% volume Tween-20, 0.1 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris pH 7.5].
Aliquot 15 µL of sample into a 1.5 mL epi-tube, incubate at 75 °C for 2 minutes, then chill on ice for 2 minutes.

Add 35 µL of CIP1 master-mix [25.25 µL ddH2O + 0.05% Tween-20, 5 µL CutSmart Buffer (NEB #B7204S), 0.75 µL Superase-In RNase Inhibitor (Thermo Fisher #AM2694), 0.5 µL RQ1 RNase-Free DNase 1,000u (Promega #M6101), 2 µL Quick CIP (NEB #M0525)] and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Incubate at 75 °C for 1 minute, then chill on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Second CIP Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of CIP treatment.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL CIP 2 master-mix [8.5 µL ddH2O + 0.05% Tween-20, 1 µL CutSmart Buffer (NEB #B7204S), 0.5 µL Quick CIP (NEB #M0525)] and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Second RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA again following CIP treatments.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL TRIzol™ LS Reagent (Thermo Fisher #10296010), vortex, and incubate at RT for 5 minutes.
Add 140 µL of TE’T and 140 µL of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol 24:1 (Merck MilliporeSigma #C0549).
Vortex well and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 x g (RT).
Transfer the upper layer into new tubes.
Add 1 µL of GlycoBlue Coprecipitant (Thermo Fisher #AM9515).
Add 1/10th volume of 3M NaOAc (pH 5.5).
Vortex for 5 seconds and add 1x volume of isopropanol. Mix by inverting 10 times and spin down briefly.
Incubate overnight at -20 °C (optionally 20 minutes at -20 °C).
Centrifuge samples for 30 minutes at MAX x g and 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and wash with 1 mL 75% EtOH. Discard EtOH, quick-spin, and remove remaining EtOH.
Air dry pellet at RT until translucent (~3 minutes). (Optional: pellet can be frozen at -80 °C indefinitely).

steps.title: RppH Treatment and 5' Ligation
steps.instruction: Process RNA with RppH and ligate the 5' adapter.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend RNA in 6 µL TET [0.05% volume Tween-20, 1 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris pH 7.5].
Denature RNA at 75 °C for 2 minutes, then chill on ice for 2 minutes.

Add 9 µL of RppH master-mix (3.25 µL ddH2O + 0.1% Tween-20, 1.5 µL T4 RNA Ligase Reaction Buffer (NEB #B0216L), 3 µL 50% PEG8000 (NEB #B1004S), 0.25 µL Superase-In RNase Inhibitor (Thermo Fisher #AM2694), 1 µL RNA 5’ Pyrophosphohydrolase (RppH) 200 units (NEB #M0356S)). Mix carefully due to PEG viscosity and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.

Add 10 µL 5’ Ligation master-mix (1 µL T4 RNA Ligase Reaction Buffer (NEB #B0216L), 2 µL 10 mM ATP (NEB), 1 µL 10 µM denatured 5' SR Adapter (NEB #E7300L), 5 µL 50% PEG8000 (NEB #B1004S), 1 µL T4 RNA Ligase 1 (ssRNA Ligase) 5,000 units (NEB #M0204L)). Note: Denature 5' SR Adapter at 75 °C for 2 minutes before creating master-mix. Mix well and incubate at 21 °C for 2 hours or 16 °C for 16 hours.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform annealing and reverse transcription of the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 7 µL of Annealing master-mix [1 µL 10 µM RS2 Primer (5'AGCGGATAACAATTTCACAGGA3'), 2 µL 700 mM KCl, 4 µL TET].
Denature RNA at 75 °C for 2 minutes, then incubate at 56 °C for 45 minutes, then cool on ice.

Add 13 µL RT master-mix [7.5 µL ddH2O + 0.05% Tween-20, 2 µL RT_KCl-10x, 2 µL 10X DTT (NEB #B1034A), 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs (Life Technologies #10297-018), 1 µL ProtoScript II Reverse Transcriptase 10,000 units (NEB #M0368L), 0.5 µL RNase Inhibitor, Murine 15,000 units (NEB #M0314L)] and incubate at 50 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: RNA Removal and Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Remove RNA and purify the cDNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase A (Qiagen #19101) and incubate for 15 minutes at 37 °C.
Add 47 µL 20% PEG / 2.5M NaCl and 3 µL Sera-Mag SpeedBeads Carboxylate-Modified Magnetic Particles (GE Healthcare #44152105050350).
Incubate at RT (0 µL specified in text). Wash 2x with 80% EtOH.
Air-dry beads until cracked (~12 minutes).
Resuspend in 15 µL of 1x Novex™ Hi-Density TBE Sample Buffer (5X) (Thermo Fisher #LC6678) and incubate at RT for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Gel Electrophoresis and Size Selection
steps.instruction: Run the sample on a gel and excise the desired band.

substeps.instruction: Run the entire sample on a 10% TBE Gel (Invitrogen-Thermo Fisher #EC62752BOX) with 0.5 µL of any 25bp ladder (80V for 15 minutes, then 180V for 1 hour 15 minutes).
Perforate 0.5 mL qubit tubes 4x with 22g needle and place inside 1.5 mL LoBind tube.
Stain the gel with 20 mL of 1x TBE Buffer + 3 µL of SYBR Gold Nucleic Acid Gel Stain (#S-11494) for 5 minutes in a RNase-free container in the dark.
Visualize and cut the gel based on desired size (e.g., for 60 bp transcripts with 118 bp adapters, look for bands in the 170-180 bp range).

steps.title: Final cDNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover and clean the cDNA from the gel slice.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 20,000 x g (RT), ensuring gel is crushed and spun down into 1.5 mL LoBind tubes (Eppendorf #022431021).
Add 160 µL of TET to each sample.
Shake samples for 45 minutes at RT (do not shake too quickly).
Transfer slurry to UltraFree MC Column (0.45 µM) (Merck Millipore #UFC30HVNB) and spin for 2 minutes at 1000 x g.
Add 100 µL of TET + 300 mM NaCl to column, incubate for 30 minutes at RT, then spin for 2 minutes at 1000 x g.
Clean up using ChIP DNA Clean & Concentrator (Zymo Research #D5205) columns according to instructions. Elute in 10 µL EB.
